name: SetupDecorator
summary: Wraps a suite so that something is set up before it runs and torn down after, so that the arrangement travels with the suite rather than with a class.

roles.name: SetupDecorator
roles.summary: A wrapper around a suite rather than a method inside a class. It is what lets an environment be arranged for a set of tests chosen at run time, and it is the piece a reader will not find by looking in the test — because it is not there.
